description_en: Queries the automatic memory collection switch
description_zh: 查询自动记忆拾取开关
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo get-memory-auto-extraction-switch --tenant-id 10001 --owner-type group --group-id cg_12345 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMemoryAutoExtractionSwitch

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The owner type. A value of user indicates the personal memory of the authenticated user, and a value of group indicates the memory of the specified collaboration workspace
parameters.help_zh: user 为鉴权用户的个人记忆；group 为指定协作空间记忆
parameters.name: owner_type

parameters.help_en: The collaboration workspace ID. This parameter is required when ownerType is set to group
parameters.help_zh: 协作空间 ID；ownerType 为 group 时必填
parameters.name: group_id

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

enabled.description_en: The status of the automatic memory collection switch for the current memory scope. A value of true indicates that the switch is enabled, and a value of false indicates that the switch is disabled
enabled.description_zh: 当前记忆范围的自动记忆拾取开关状态；true 表示已开启，false 表示已关闭

message.example: 当前用户不是群组 cg_12345 的活跃成员
